dataList.place:
红色精品店，3楼
 Boutique du Rouge, 3F
dataList.content:
……那天我们在甜甜圈巷的一家餐厅吃玛格丽特披萨的时候，你穿的就是这件。你还抱怨说这身衣服穿着难受，闹了肠胃不适。
 ... You wore it on the day we had margherita pizza at a restaurant in the Donut Alley. You did complain about digestive troubles on account of the discomfort caused by the outfit.

虽然你更喜欢靠窗的位子，但那家餐厅订位系统出了点问题，把我们安排在了大厅正中央——这一点你也觉得挺遗憾的。
 Though you preferred the window seat, the issue with the reservation system at the restaurant seated us in the middle of the hall—which you also found regrettable.

<color=#a5ab8e>……有人或许会觉得你是个真正的浪漫主义者。仅凭前任低语的一句话，就能把整整一天重新唤醒、染上色彩，仿佛那事就发生在昨天。仿佛与她共度的每一件事，他都不曾遗忘分毫。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>... Some might see a true romantic in you. A man who brings back to life and color an entire day just from a single word whispered by his ex-lover—as though it happened just yesterday. As though he couldn't forget a single thing done in her company.</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>不过你那出色的记忆力，不过是你小时候被迫接受的记忆训练带来的机械式结果罢了。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>But your excellent memory is just the logical, mechanical outcome of childhood mnemonic training you were subjected to.</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>不过你搞错了。那天我生气的根本不是靠窗座位的事。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>You've got it wrong, though. It wasn't the window seat I was angry about that day.</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>我生气是因为，你看到我的新裙子，第一句话就是叫我拿去换个大一号的。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>I was angry because the first thing you said when you saw my new dress was that I should return it and get something a size larger.</color>

确实需要换大一号。那件衣服太紧了，日常活动中带来了不少麻烦。
 It was true that you needed to go up a size. The tightness of the outfit was presenting various difficulties in mundane activities.
没错，可你非得当面这么说吗？你本可以先夸夸我的裙子，然后就此打住的。 Right, but did you have to say that to my face? You could've just complimented my dress and moved on.

<color=#a5ab8e>不管怎样，随着我穿那条裙子的时间越久，起初的不适感也渐渐被我抛到了脑后。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>Anyway, the initial discomfort slowly receded to the back of my mind the longer I wore that dress.</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>可当我换上更舒服的衣服……那种令人窒息的不适感一下子全涌了上来，我才意识到，自己一直都在跟一件根本不合我尺寸的衣服较劲。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>But when I changed into something more comfortable... That stifling discomfort rushed in all at once, and I realized that, all along, I had been wrestling with an outfit that wasn't made for my size.</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>这个比喻用在那位赤红者身上也很贴切……只不过，跟我不同，她拒绝换上更舒服的衣服。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>It's a fitting analogy for that Rouge, too... Though, unlike me, she's refused to change into something more comfortable.</color>

我猜测是默尔索母亲的声音，仍在墙壁后某处回响——那是一个再也不会说出新话语的声音。
 The voice of whom I presume to be Meursault's mother is still playing from somewhere behind the walls—the voice that will never again speak new words.

dataList.title:
赤红者
 Le Rouge
dataList.content:
是啊，是啊……我做的一切……那一切一定都有意义……有目的……
 Yes, yes... Everything I did... all of that had to have meant something... A purpose...

dataList.title:
赤红者
 Le Rouge
dataList.content:
我一直在剥去金皮，是因为……对，就是这样。
 I've been flaying the Golden Hide off because... yes, that's it.

<color=#a5ab8e>唔，这倒是出乎意料。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>Hmm, this is unexpected.</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>"有意义"，嗯……？不知道她找到了什么样的意义呢？真是费解。简直就像她听到的是一个完全不同的"声音"。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>"Meant something," hmm...? What meaning did this one find, I wonder? How puzzling. It's almost as if she's hearing an entirely different Voice.</color>

<color=#a5ab8e>这次你打算无视我吗？那样也不失为一个不错的选择。</color>
 <color=#a5ab8e>You're going to ignore me this time? That's not a bad choice either, I guess.</color>

dataList.title:
赤红者
 Le Rouge
dataList.content:
它又在对我说话了……再一次……传得如此清晰，不曾中断，不曾消散……
 It's speaking to me... once again... It's coming through so clearly, without breaking, without fading...

dataList.title:
赤红者
 Le Rouge
dataList.content:
它叫我用尖钉刺穿这身衣服……把它整个撕碎……说我赤裸的躯干之中，才能找到真正的自我……
 Telling me to put my nails to this outfit... to rip it all away... That in my naked body, I'll find my true self...

<她正在变成这里所说的"人偶"……>
 <She's turning into a "Mannequin," as they call it in here...>

<虽然阶段各不相同，但我们在西西弗百货遇到的赤红者和漆黑者员工，无一例外都在扭曲。不过……她这个进展快得多……>
 <Though they were all in different stages, all the Rouge and Noir employees we'd encountered in the Grand Magasin were Distorting without exception. But... her case is progressing much quicker...>

dataList.title:
赤红者
 Le Rouge
dataList.content:
终于……在从我身上蜕落、蜕落了。把这些令人窒息的东西从我身上剥掉……我想成为真正的自己……
 It's finally... sloughing, sloughing off me. Take these stifling things off of me... I want to be my true self...

 Le Rouge Mannequin
dataList.content:
是不是也有人把那些谎言披到了你身上？
 Has someone draped those lies over you, too?

dataList.title:

 Le Rouge Mannequin
dataList.content:
来吧，我来把你从那些压迫你的衣物中解放出来……你会感受到……和我一样的感觉……
 Come, I'll liberate you from those oppressive clothes... And you'll feel... just like I do...
